description: Add the complete task system to AG TaskFlow: data model (tasks[], taskGroups[], cardTaskLinks[]), task panel component with split-view and full-screen modes, keyboard shortcuts (T to toggle panel, Shift+T to link focused card), right-click 'Add to Tasks' context menu option, task status indicator on linked cards, and task grouping with reorderable groups.
steps: Create src/TaskPanel.jsx as a new component file. This panel receives tasks, taskGroups, cardTaskLinks, and relevant handlers as props. It renders: (1) a header with mode toggle (split/fullscreen) and close button, (2) task groups (Today, Later, Waiting, Research, Follow-up) that are reorderable via up/down buttons, (3) task items within each group showing: linked card reference chip, task title, checkbox, status selector (not started/in progress/completed/blocked), optional note field. Style it to match existing app conventions: white bg, border-slate-200, rounded-lg, shadow-sm, text-slate-800, Tailwind utility classes, Lucide icons.

In src/App.jsx, add the task system state variables after the Mini Map States section (~line 377): tasks (array), taskGroups (array with default groups: Today, Later, Waiting, Research, Follow-up), cardTaskLinks (array). Also add showTaskPanel (boolean), taskPanelMode ('split' or 'fullscreen') state variables. Initialize taskGroups with 5 default groups each having id, name, and order fields.

In src/App.jsx, add the linkedTaskIds field to card data model. When cards are loaded or created, ensure they have linkedTaskIds: [] (backwards compatible). In the addNode function (~line 2558), add linkedTaskIds: [] to the newNode object.

Add task CRUD functions in App.jsx: addTaskFromCard(cardId) - creates a task linked to the card, using the card's title as task title, creates a cardTaskLink entry, and adds the task ID to the card's linkedTaskIds. Also: updateTask(taskId, updates), deleteTask(taskId), toggleTaskStatus(taskId), moveTaskToGroup(taskId, groupId), reorderGroups(fromIndex, toIndex).

Add keyboard shortcut for T key (toggle task panel open/close) in a new useEffect, following the pattern of the M key handler at ~line 1266. Guard against INPUT/TEXTAREA focus, and ctrl/meta/alt/shift modifiers.

Add keyboard shortcut for Shift+T (link focused card to task panel). When Shift+T is pressed and focusedNodeId is set, call addTaskFromCard(focusedNodeId). Follow the existing keyboard shortcut pattern.

Add 'Add to Tasks' option to the node context menu (nodeContextMenu JSX at ~line 4431). Insert a new button before the divider/delete section. Use a CheckSquare or ListTodo icon from Lucide. On click, call addTaskFromCard(nodeContextMenu.nodeId) and close the menu.

Add task status indicator to card rendering (~line 4080 area where cards are rendered). When a card has linkedTaskIds.length > 0, show a small status icon in the top-right corner of the card. Determine the status color from the linked task's status: gray for 'not_started', blue for 'in_progress', green for 'completed', amber for 'blocked'. The indicator should be a small 8x8 or 10x10 rounded-full dot positioned absolute top-2 right-2.

Integrate TaskPanel into the layout. In the main flex layout (the div with className 'flex-1 flex overflow-hidden w-full relative'), conditionally render TaskPanel beside the canvas when showTaskPanel is true and taskPanelMode is 'split'. In split mode, both the canvas <main> and <TaskPanel> share the space 50/50. In fullscreen mode, hide the canvas and show TaskPanel full width. Import TaskPanel at the top of App.jsx.

Add a 'Tasks' button to the left sidebar (aside element ~line 3745) below the Clone Nodes button. Use a ListTodo or CheckSquare icon. When clicked, toggle showTaskPanel. Style it similarly to the Clone Nodes button.

Persist task data to localStorage alongside the existing project system. In the auto-save useEffect that writes to localStorage (~line 773), include tasks, taskGroups, and cardTaskLinks in the project data. In the initialization/load logic (~line 430), read them back, defaulting to empty arrays if not present.

Add reorder functionality for task groups: each group header has up/down arrow buttons. Clicking up swaps the group with the one above it in the order; clicking down swaps with the one below. The order field in taskGroups controls the display order.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds without errors
Pressing T key (when not in input/textarea) toggles the task panel open/closed
Task panel opens in split view mode by default (50/50 with canvas)
Task panel has a button to switch to full-screen mode (hides canvas)
Pressing Shift+T when a card is focused creates a linked task item in the task panel
Right-clicking a card shows 'Add to Tasks' in the context menu, which creates a linked task
Cards linked to tasks display a small colored status dot in their top-right corner
Task status dot colors: gray (not started), blue (in progress), green (completed), amber (blocked)
Task items show: linked card reference, title, checkbox, status, optional note
Task groups (Today, Later, Waiting, Research, Follow-up) are displayed and reorderable
Task data persists across page reloads via localStorage
The sidebar has a 'Tasks' button that also toggles the task panel
verification: Run 'npm run build' in /projects/sandbox/mindmap5 and confirm exit code 0 with no errors
